description:
Bubble Bobble for AP is the NES classic with progression locked behind the password
system, only allowing the player to go to a level if they have the letters required
for one of its passwords.

1.1.1.description: APworld generates most of the time but does not have a client yet.
1.1.1.title: inaugural release

1.1.2.title: Let's pretend I know what I'm doing

v1.1.4.description: This generates consistently and sends checks.  It's partially playable, but not completable yet, and several features are not yet coded.
v1.1.4.title: v1.1.4

v1.1.5.description:
I think traps, extra starting lives, sending checks, and preventing using letters you don't have are all working features now.

Differentiating Super Bubble Bobble levels does NOT work.  If you try to play with separate Super Bubble Bobble levels, your game will generate, but half your checks will be inaccessible.

Sending completion has not been set up yet, either.
v1.1.5.title: v1.1.5

v1.1.6.description: Lots of untested stuff, have fun
v1.1.6.title: The "fuck it we ball" release

v1.1.7.title: The "maybe we shouldn't have balled yet" release

v1.1.8.description:
BIG CHANGES
What is tested:
Bizhawk authenticates on its own with a patched ROM.
Checks send.
Bubble bounce is blocked.
At least lightning bubbles are blocked from spawning.

What's not tested:
A lot of changes to how it writes to RAM, including things that worked before and should still work now, but slightly differently and hopefully more efficiently.
Other elements should be blocked the same way lightning is.
Hopefully the code added to make sending checks work will work more consistently before.
Thoroughly rewrote how completion is sent, but do not have time to do a full run right now and try it yet.
Added code to lock powerups (the candies, speedy shoes, and drug of thunder), which will hopefully work just light the lightning bubble block does.
New code for increasing starting lives.
Death link.
Probably more stuff I can't remember.

BIGGEST THANKS EVER to HappyHappyism.  Could not have gotten 1/4 of what I've done without his help.  Check out his ActRaiser apworld; it's a lot of fun.
v1.1.8.title: The "I think version numbers are meaningless" update

v1.1.9.description:
Fixed a crash that occurred when bouncing on bubbles in the boss fight.
Fixed issues with the drug of thunder not taking full effect.
Fixed a bug that allowed you to access way more levels than you should be able to access (but caused a bug that sometimes game overs you when going to levels you should be able to access)

Tested a lot of stuff, and most things are working now.
